newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Gold sells diamond explorer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Gold sells diamond explorer.

text.p: Australian Gold Fields NL (AFN) said on Tuesday it had agreed to sell its wholly-owned diamond exploration unit Jade Creek Resources NL to Striker Resources NL in return for the issue of 20.252 million Striker ordinary shares and the same number of December 1999 options.
AFN said it would become Striker's largest shareholder with a 19.9 percent stake and take three board positions.
Striker currently has 80.19 million shares on issue. Its shares opened three cents lower at 19 cents.
AFN said it would become a pure gold company, while retaining an exposure to Jade's exploration tenements in Western Australia.
